title: Thai Pea Risotto
description: A creamy and flavorful Thai-inspired risotto dish featuring peas and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add peas and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add risotto and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add fish sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, until risotto is creamy and cooked through.
Stir in sugar and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the risotto is well combined and the sweetness is balanced.
